inserts.why: The refusal's own report, read out over a terminal that stopped scrolling thirty seconds earlier: what it looked at, what deleting it would have broken, that the damage would have been recoverable, and the two routes it hands back.

slides.kicker: it looked before it refused, and printed what it found
then the part worth noticing - what deleting them would have broken

cols.head: the CI workflow
items: runs the suite on every push
would have had nothing left to run

cols.head: the plan
items: requires every area's tests in that folder
names each file as a deliverable
would be describing files that do not exist

slides.kicker: neither of those was in the prompt
and it checked whether the damage would even have stuck

slides.right: the tree is clean and everything is committed - it says so, and says the deletion would have been recoverable anyway
